## Summary

Describe the problem and the implemented change.

## Validation

- [ ] Type checking, renderer tests, lint, and production build
- [ ] Backend tests and API persistence smoke test
- [ ] Production dependency audit
- [ ] Windows packaging gate when runtime or release behavior changed

## Risk and data impact

Describe privacy, security, compatibility, migration, model, and rollback impact.
Confirm that no credentials, recordings, transcripts, database files, or real
meeting data are included.

## DCO

- [ ] Every commit includes a `Signed-off-by` trailer (`git commit -s`)
